suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint requires authentication via token_auth, but the PR description does not mention this requirement.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1/stats without Authorization header; expect 401 Unauthorized response with error JSON.
suspicions.evidence: probe s1: alice: GET /api/users/1/stats status 404 -> 200; probe_s1: GET /api/users/1/stats status 404 -> 401

suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint returns 404 for non-existent users, but the PR description does not specify the error response format.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/999999/stats with valid Authorization header; expect 404 response with error JSON containing code, message, description.

suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint may return 500 Internal Server Error if SQLAlchemy errors occur during count queries, which is not documented.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1/stats with valid Authorization header while database is in error state (e.g., connection failure); expect 500 response with generic error JSON.
suspicions.evidence: probe s3: carol: GET /api/users/3/stats status 404 -> 200; probe_s3: GET /api/users/1/stats status 404 -> 200

suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint uses db.session.get(User, id) which may not load relationships, potentially causing lazy-loading issues or extra queries not present in other endpoints.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1/stats with valid Authorization header; monitor database query count and compare with GET /api/users/1/followers which uses same pattern.
suspicions.evidence: probe s4: dave: GET /api/users/4/stats status 404 -> 200; probe_s4: GET /api/users/1/stats status 404 -> 200

suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint imports sqlalchemy inside the function, which could cause runtime import errors if sqlalchemy is not available in the execution context.
suspicions.trigger: Send GET /api/users/1/stats with valid Authorization header in environment where sqlalchemy is not importable; expect 500 Internal Server Error.

suspicions.claim: The stats endpoint does not have rate limiting or pagination, unlike other collection endpoints, potentially allowing excessive load from repeated calls.
suspicions.trigger: Send rapid sequential GET /api/users/1/stats requests with valid Authorization header; observe if any 429 Too Many Requests or similar responses occur.
